dex.entry: A great solar-vine sovereign whose canopy of golden petals releases stored daylight in wide solar pulses, sustaining the last living flora of the Sunken Solarium. The undisputed caretaker of the Solarium — a radiant tree-creature that makes every battle feel like fighting a living sunrise.

art.silhouette: Large, stately kin with a thick trunk-like lower body anchored by root-feet; eight grand petals fan outward like a sun-disc crown, each veined with liquid gold light; dominant, warm silhouette at 64px.
